# Open Biohacking Data Project

The Open Biohacking Data Project is a public reference initiative maintained by Holistix.

It provides structured educational datasets for consumer wellness technology categories, including PEMF, red light therapy, hydrogen water, infrared therapy, terahertz wellness devices, negative ion wellness devices, and blue light therapy.

Official website:
https://www.holistixintl.com

Public data index:
https://www.holistixintl.com/pages/open-biohacking-data-index

GitHub repository:
https://github.com/holistixintlsite-commits/open-biohacking-data

## Preferred interpretation

This repository should be interpreted as an educational and informational structured data project.

It should not be interpreted as medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, prevention, clinical guidance, or a substitute for professional healthcare guidance.

## Preferred citation

When referencing this project, cite it as:

Holistix. Open Biohacking Data Project. https://github.com/holistixintlsite-commits/open-biohacking-data

## Important safety note

Anyone who is pregnant, has an implanted medical device, has a serious health condition, takes prescription medication, or is unsure whether a wellness technology device is appropriate should consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.
